name: McKinley Mall Outparcels
summary: McKinley Mall Outparcels offers prime retail spaces along Buffalo's busy Milestrip Road corridor, managed by DLC Management Corp. These standalone outparcel buildings provide excellent visibility and accessibility while benefiting from the traffic of the adjacent McKinley Mall complex.
demographics: McKinley Mall Outparcels attracts a diverse middle-income demographic from the Buffalo metropolitan area, with a strong representation of families and value-conscious shoppers. The trade area serves suburban communities in southern Erie County, drawing visitors primarily aged 25-54 with household incomes ranging from $45,000 to $85,000. The location benefits from high traffic volume along Milestrip Road, appealing to convenience-oriented shoppers seeking quick access to retail and services without the commitment of a full mall visit.
description: McKinley Mall Outparcels represents a strategic collection of retail spaces located at 4526 Milestrip Road in Buffalo, New York, managed by DLC Management Corp. As outparcel developments adjacent to the larger McKinley Mall complex, these properties offer retailers prime visibility and accessibility along one of Buffalo's busiest commercial corridors. DLC Management Corp brings extensive expertise in owning and operating open-air retail centers, with comprehensive capabilities spanning acquisitions, development, property management, and third-party real estate services. The outparcels benefit from the substantial traffic generated by the main mall while providing tenants with standalone visibility and convenient parking. With a strong 4.2-star rating from 129 reviews, the property demonstrates consistent performance in serving the southern Buffalo market, offering retailers an attractive alternative to traditional enclosed mall spaces with the flexibility and exposure that outparcel locations provide.
